nombre_oficial.texto: The Temple of the Warriors and the Thousand Columns

frase_gancho.texto: A forest of carved pillars built for council and war.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: East of the Great Leveling are the buildings with columns, a style of construction very different from the temples with narrow chambers. There are five stops. You will see the Temple of the Warriors, with its Chac Mool at the top, the colonnade with warrior figures that accompanies it, and the older temple it holds inside. Then comes the great plaza of the Thousand Columns. Next are the Temple of the Great Tables, discovered in the 1990s, and a steam bath, the temazcal. The Market closes the tour, which today is thought to have been more ceremonial than commercial.
